meaning.en: The characteristic of being objective; neutrality.
meaning.vi: Đặc tính của khách quan; tính trung lập.

sentences.en: Justice, objectiveness and impartiality are our ideal in reporting.

sentences.en: Beauty should have the qualities of truth, objectiveness, social utility, emotion and novelty.

sentences.en: In fact, objectiveness and subjectiveness are always depended upon one another in literary history writing.

sentences.en: Once there isnindependence in CPA, the objectiveness and justness of the auditing results will be suspected.

sentences.en: In the analysis and comments, we strive for objectiveness, reasonableness, depth and width.

sentences.en: Higher education has the characteristics of objectiveness, multi - dimension and neutralism.

sentences.en: Their genuineness, objectiveness and completeness all bear upon the study of music figures in history.

sentences.en: For medical fault, the objectiveness of fault and the presumption of fault should be applied.

sentences.en: You have talked about the modern physics several times that we all had ever learned about , as it was the source and primogenitor of science , why could it question the objectiveness in reverse ?
